title: Modifying items of an extended array does not trigger re-computation

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Vue version

3.5.0-rc.1

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://play.vuejs.org/#

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a class that extends `Array`, and add a method that calls `super`
2. Create a computed value that uses that method to find an item
3. Change a property on the item

### What is expected?

The computed value should update

### What is actually happening?

Computed value does not re-evaluate

### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: macOS 14.4.1
    CPU: (10) arm64 Apple M1 Pro
    Memory: 233.67 MB / 32.00 GB
    Shell: 5.9 - /bin/zsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 18.15.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v18.15.0/bin/node
    npm: 9.5.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v18.15.0/bin/npm
    pnpm: 9.7.0 - ~/Library/pnpm/pnpm
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 128.0.6613.113
    Firefox Nightly: 129.0a1
    Safari: 17.4.1
```


### Any additional comments?

This was working in [beta.1](https://play.vuejs.org/#), and stopped working in [beta.2](https://play.vuejs.org/#). This failure is different from versions >= [beta.3](https://play.vuejs.org/#) though. In beta.2, the source value does not update, so it's unclear if the computed property would have re-evaluated.

This regression is likely related to fixes from earlier tickets,
https://github.com/vuejs/core/issues/11570
https://github.com/vuejs/core/issues/11573
https://github.com/vuejs/core/issues/11628 ← this was very similar, but it accessed item by index instead of method
